verdict.rationale: Pylon documents AI Issue QA rubrics that apply at the agent and issue level, so AI agent conversations can be scored against guidelines. It also has an issue log for inspecting the AI agent's outcomes and steps, on a page framed as 'monitor and iterate'. That covers scoring and review, but the docs show neither ongoing sampling, nor automatic flagging of failures, nor a documented loop that turns QA findings into agent fixes such as runbook updates. Missing for 10: ongoing/scheduled sampling of AI conversations, explicit failure flagging, a documented review-to-fix feedback loop into the agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, AI conversations get ongoing QA — scored samples, flagged failures, and a review loop that feeds fixes back into the agent

citations.quote: Create rubrics to enforce that processes are being followed on the agent and issue level.
Apply rubrics to issues to make sure guidelines and process are being followed.
The issue log allows you to inspect all the issues the AI agent is associated with and inspect the outcomes and steps taken by the AI.
